description: Monitor the Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity sessions of the current folder in one sidebar, and handle approvals, questions, work progress, and subscription limits.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: In Restricted Mode, the session list is shown read-only; hook activity, inline approvals, and subscription limit checks are turned off.
configuration.title: Agent Session Monitor
config.notifications.description: Which session events notify you. In the window you are using they arrive as VS Code notifications; when you are away from it, as macOS notifications.
config.notifications.attentionAndDone: Waiting for approval or an answer, errors, and finished replies
config.notifications.attention: Waiting for approval or an answer, and errors
config.notifications.off: Only update the list and status bar
config.chatLocation.description: Where a chat opens when you click a session title or the new chat button.
config.chatLocation.secondarySidebar: Show chats in the Secondary Side Bar
config.chatLocation.lastUsed: Use the location the tool used last
config.subscriptionUsage.description: While the panel is visible, check subscription usage and reset times for the official tools you are signed in to. Each tool is checked automatically every 5 minutes.
config.inlineActions.description: While the Agent Session Monitor panel is visible, handle approval requests and choice questions (including several questions and multiple selection) from the main Claude Code session of the VS Code extension here. Codex, Antigravity, subagents, and plan approvals show a read-only preview and are handled in their chat.
config.awayNotifications.description: When the VS Code window is not active, send waiting approvals and answers, errors, and new replies as native macOS notifications with the agent logo. Clicking one takes you straight to the VS Code window of that project.
config.notificationSound.description: Play the system sound when a native macOS notification is shown.
config.inlineActionSeconds.description: How many seconds a Claude Code approval request or question can be answered right here in the panel. After that, it is handled in the official chat.
config.otherFolders.description: Below the list, show how many sessions in folders not open in this window are waiting for an approval or answer.
config.activityDetail.description: Show each session’s request, plan checklist, steps, changed files, and a summary of the last reply. This is kept in memory only, never in the extension’s snapshot on disk (but when awayNotifications is on, inactive-window macOS notifications include a short summary).
command.markAllSeen: Mark All New Replies as Read
command.allowOpenRequest: Allow Open Request or Send Answer
